reviews.text: I hired Beyond the Dog as a last resort for my rescued pitbull. He has aggression problems and had started attacking one of my other dogs. He also was very uncomfortable with strangers in our house, to the point that we were wary of having people over. I was specifically looking for training for aggressive dogs. I have tried many other types of training but it was not what was going to work, they were more dog obedience vs aggressive dog training like Beyond the Dog. Shyenne was our trainer, and what can I even say?  She came in, knowledgeable, confident, and kind and understanding. Over several weeks of in home training, we began to have hope we would be safe having Frito stay in our home. It changed our lives because now we can keep our beloved dog in our home with a plan on how to keep our other dogs and guests safe. When before we had no ideas or other options, Shyenne came in and gave me a plan, the tools i needed, and the confidence in myself to follow through once the training was done. If I ever need any kind of training it all, it would only be with Beyong the Dog. All of the other training programs never worked at all. Thank you sweet Shyenne!  We love you!!

Shyenne has been amazing with Bonnie! Before we started training, Bonnie was constantly pulling on the leash and completely obsessed with chasing lizards, which made walks pretty chaotic. After just a month of sessions with Shyenne, the difference is incredible. Bonnie is now walking calmly right by my side and is so much more focused and manageable on walks. Shyenne is patient, knowledgeable, and clearly understands how to work with each dog’s personality. We are so impressed with the progress Bonnie has made and couldn’t recommend Shyenne more!

When we adopted Ellie, she had been abandoned after being hit by a car. She is the sweetest, funniest dog, but she also came with some significant behavioral challenges. We struggled with barking, reactivity, lunging, and after she bit someone, we knew she needed more help than we could provide on our own.

After a lot of research, Beyond the Dog stood out because of their philosophy. I loved their relationship-based approach and their focus on understanding dog psychology rather than relying on fear or pain.

My husband and I both work full time and have an almost two-year-old, so we made the difficult decision to send Ellie from Houston to Florida for their Board & Train program. From my first conversations with Alexis and Allison to watching Sean pick Ellie up, I felt confident she was in the right hands. Dogs know dog people, and Ellie knew.

When Ellie came home, she was still the same goofy, loving dog we adored, but now she had the skills to thrive. Walks are enjoyable instead of stressful, and she can safely be part of our daily life with a young child. The transfer training was just as important as the board and train itself and gave us the confidence to continue her progress at home.

Meeting Shelby, Ellie’s trainer in Florida, was the moment everything came full circle. Seeing the bond they had built and hearing about their walks, coffee runs, and time spent together made it obvious that Ellie wasn’t just trained—she was genuinely loved.

I’m incredibly grateful to Sean, Shelby, Alexis, Allison, and everyone at Beyond the Dog. I truly believe that when you adopt a dog, you commit to them for life, and Beyond the Dog gave us the tools to honor that commitment. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

Shyenne McCowan is definitely a very excellent dog trainer. She solved all the problems my dog Sweetie has. My dog used to be reactive to vacuum cleaner, microwave and hair dryer. After this training class, she is pretty relaxed with all those items now. The most important thing is that Sweetie can walk by my side and follow my steps during current dog walkings. She taught me a lot of methods to train my dog and they are all very useful for me. I really love her and we have built a good relationship during the last two months. I really recommend her for the professional ability and the kind attitude.

Shyenne did a wonderful job training our Great Dane, Jane! She is much more obedient and the best part is I now know how to teach her myself. Shyenne is very knowledgeable and you can tell she enjoys what she does. Highly recommend!

I called Beyond The Dog to ask about training options for our lab mix 8 month old puppy, Vanilla. We had issues with excitability, jumping on guests and nipping. Vanilla is a great dog but all my training efforts just weren’t working and I was going thru puppy blues. Decided to go with their 4 week in home training. Abby was our trainer and I’m so happy that she was able to help us so much. Abby was outstanding in every way. She was professional, calm and took time to understand Vanilla. Abby got to know us and our wants and needs. She worked with our dog 3 x week, and with us once a week. Abby answered all our questions & sent weekly recaps of the training. Vanilla is 100% better and we are continuing to train her everyday using the techniques we learned. I highly recommend and encourage anyone with dog training concerns to use Beyond The Dog.🐾 Thank YOU so very much ABBY, you’re the BEST!!!

Shyenne is the best! She was a wonderful trainer and I sincerely appreciate her help with my reactive dog, Merlin.

I decided to invest in Beyond the Dog training because Merlin would bark and lunge at other dogs when I'd walk him in my apartment complex. It felt like any attempt I made to help only made him more reactive over time, and I needed professional help.

Shyenne trained Merlin well, and taught us both how to handle these stressful situations. She went above and beyond answering questions, providing feedback, and being a reassuring presence throughout the training.

After six weeks, we're no longer on edge walking near other dogs! Merlin's come so far, can't thank Shyenne enough!

Never had this done before so i dont have a barometer but experience was pleasant, did a great job. Our dog was very often in hyper mode with lots and lots of bad habits. She is a puppy so we know that she will have some issues for a couple of years but now she is very manageable and is growing into the right direction. We are better for the training as well, as humans. Very satisfied.

If you are a cat owner seeking cat training services, look elsewhere. As you can see, 99.9% of the reviews for this company are from dog owners and now, unfortunately, I know why. They know absolutely nothing about how to train cats.
We have been keeping our cats separated because of fighting, so we hired a trainer to come out to our home to help us reintegrate them.
Before the trainer came, she asked us to have the cats in their harnesses, even though our cats have had zero harness training and for them to be in separate rooms where they can’t hide from her, which was an odd request.
She spent absolutely no time trying to bond with our cats and decided that on the very first day, the cats were ready to be in the same room together.  What? They haven’t been in the same room together in months.
They are wearing harnesses, which they do not like wearing, there is a stranger in close proximity, and they have been put in the same room together. What could go wrong.
Needless to say, everything went wrong.  The cats freaked out. They were so stressed. One was trying desperately to hide, but was trapped by the trainer.
To top it off, the trainer texted later and thought the cats seemed relaxed when she left. OMG, seriously.
It was a terrible experience for the cats and for us.
You don’t have to be an animal behavior specialist to know all the things the trainer was doing was wrong. Any pet owner with any common sense would know that.
We canceled the rest of the sessions. Lost our $250 deposit and money for the training session.

What is more disappointing is the owner of the company, Dr. Savage, never reached out to ask why we canceled the rest of the sessions and never asked about our experience with the trainer.  You would think, as the owner, she would want to know what happened.
Shyenne was amazing in our helping our puppy with TV reactivity. She has successfully graduated from the program and we are grateful to Beyond the Dog for working with her! Would highly recommend.

Our saga began with a super sweet but highly reactive dog, Cash, a 6 year old dachshund who is a bit larger than average - 20 lbs. He hid or barked at company, severe avoidance behavior and anxiety, and was difficult to walk anywhere close to people or other dogs. He had managed to pass three conventional dog training group classes over the years, but the trainings completely failed in real world environments.

We were moving to a busy urban area in April, where he would need to be in close daily contact with people/dogs, and move from a house with yard to apartment living. Cash needed to be even better than the average dog.

We contacted Beyond the Dog in Jan 2026, and they believed they could actually help Cash. We met our trainer Shyenne and she began 1:1 training four days a week - in real world environments. Cash proved to be a difficult case and was off to a slow start, no surprise. But within the first few weeks we started to see a change, a much calmer version.

Over the next three and a half months Cash improved to the point he was calm and friendly with people who came over including my parents - who could not believe the difference in Cash. He could be walked in active environments with people, dogs, and especially children (previous deep fear of children/strollers). Outdoors and indoors (thanks Ross Dress for Less).

May follow up report: we have moved and Cash has successfully made the transition, virtually zero barking at noises in apartment living, riding elevators, walking and sitting at cafes. We are taking him on longer walks over time, and utilizing the training and tools Shyenne taught us as he further acclimates to his new environment.

We can’t thank Shyenne and Beyond the Dog enough for the incredible ‘life changing’ improvement in Cash (and his sibling Pimm) that has allowed us to enjoy our new urban environment!!

10/10 highly recommended!
.

Shyenne was assigned to help with specialized behavioral training for my dog Tobi. Tobi was having some challenges adjusting to his new human baby sister after being an only child for so many years, but Shyenne guided us through a curriculum that resulted in not just a much improved relationship between the two of them, but a much more settled Tobi. She was amazing in coming up with a tailored program to address all our concerns and adjusted to Tobi's progress as we went along. Couldn't have asked for a better outcome!

We can’t say enough great things about Abby! When we first started working with her, our dog Theia was extremely aggressive and hyper-focused on our newborn, and we were honestly thinking we would have to rehome her. Abby completely turned things around for us.
Not only did she help Theia become calm, safe, and manageable around our baby, but she also taught her to listen and respond so much better overall. The transformation has been incredible, and our whole household is happier and more at ease because of it.
On top of that, the training process was actually enjoyable for us and for Theia! Abby is patient, knowledgeable, and truly cares about both the dogs and their families.
We’re so grateful we found her. Highly recommend!

Our Murphy boy has become such a good boy after the diligent and caring training provided by Shyenne who is an amazing trainer and great at what she does. He loved her so do we! Thanks for everything!

I cannot recommend Beyond the Dog Training in Houston enough. They have worked with both of my dogs—Annie, my one-year-old puppy, and Chico—and the transformation has been incredible.

They helped us address multiple challenges, including Chico’s excessive barking and Annie’s anxiety, and also guided me on how to better manage both dogs during leash walks. The training has been practical, effective, and truly tailored to each of my dogs. The transformation has been remarkable—Annie has become a much more confident girl, and Chico is now a calmer, more relaxed dog.

What makes them exceptional is the level of care and love they bring. Shyenne, our trainer, feels like part of the family. She is incredibly attentive, patient, and genuinely treats my dogs as if they were her own. My dogs absolutely adore her, and I trust her completely—which says a lot, as I am very vigilant about who I trust with them.

I initially purchased a package and have continued with maintenance sessions because the consistency has been so valuable—not just for their training, but because of the positive impact Shyenne has had on their lives.

It’s rare to find someone so passionate and dedicated to what they do, and it truly shows in the results. I’ve already recommended Beyond the Dog Training to friends, and they’ve had great experiences as well.

Grateful to have found them!

An absolute must for dog training! Sheyenne trained our puppy Fred and was amazing! We did a few nights of boarding and then four weeks of daily sessions, and within a few days the improvements in behavior and obedience were apparent. Extremely thorough but gentle and friendly, this is the ideal training that is a must for any dog. Sheyenne even helped us some with our older dog, and was always available to answer any questions. Highly recommend!

Beyond the dog was referred to me by a couple of friends after I disclosed to them that our puppy, although well intentioned, was just badly mannered and it was causing a ton of stress at the house as we also have a three-year-old toddler.

After doing some research, I bit the bullet and decided to go with the service. We did five weeks and I must say it was an incredible experience, both for our family and in just understanding the nuances of dog training. We worked with both Shelby and Shyenne, both of whom were great. In addition to them training the dog well and our dog Zola loving them, they were very good at educating and keeping us in the know about what we need to be doing in order for this to stick. Just good people.

Just know, Dog training requires that both parties really commit and it's an ongoing process but the results have been fantastic. Zola is a much better dog now. It makes life at home significantly better.

I cannot recommend Beyond the Dog enough! 10/10. If you're considering this, do it.
Shyenne did an awesome job with Hamilton, Lincoln, and Penny. What was once chaos is now order…it was exactly what they needed and was done quickly and efficiently. Life is easier now!
Shyenne was amazing with our three pups! She came in and quickly gave us the skills we needed to live together peacefully with well trained dogs.

I cannot say enough positive things about the expert and loving training our puppy, Koa, received from Shyenne McCowan.  The whole experience with Beyond the Dog training was so impressive, supportive and tailored to our personal needs/goals. Our first interaction was actually with Dr. Savage, founder, who voluntarily initiated a supportive/instructional zoom call after hearing I had called Beyond the Dog with questions due to struggling with our pup's behavior. We saw immediate results.  She then hand picked Shyenne for our in personal training needs and wow!  Shyenne was a perfect fit from the minute she walked in our door. Not only is she a terrific as a person but most impressively she is a dedicated, knowledgeable, passionate professional. Shyenne's true commitment to, knowledge and delivery of science based positive and effective training is game changing and I would recommend her and Beyond the Dog without hesitation.  Koa is an amazing part of our family.  Shyenne was able to coach us to be the owners we need to be for Koa to be his very best and happiest.
Shelby was a wonderful trainer. My dog made great progress.

Shelby is the BEST!!! My dog Ollie has serious resource guarding issues (specifically with food) and reactivity toward other dogs in public places. I reached out to Beyond the Dog after an especially scary incident between Ollie and the other dog in my home. Shelby helped me understand the signs of resource guarding, how to mitigate the chance of altercations occurring, and also did training/obedience techniques with Ollie that has made him so much more manageable at home. Ollie is also a “velcro dog” with separation anxiety, so it’s been tough to find someone that Ollie trusts and is comfortable with. Shelby was so patient with Ollie and I was so impressed to see how quickly Ollie took to her and he actually looks forward to their sessions! Shelby has also helped address his reactivity in public places. Before, he would pull on his leash on walks and would bark at almost every dog we saw on the street. Ollie now walks right next to me on walks and doesn’t bark or pull when he sees other dogs. I can’t recommend beyond the dog and Shelby enough!

My dog Franklin just completed a training program with Shyenne as his trainer. Franklin started as a wild shelter dog with no manners. Franklin’s reactivity on walks and behavior indoors are much improved now. He often gets compliments on how well behaved he is now. I have good tools to keep working with him. Franklin also had lots of fun training and loved Shyenne. I recommend this program to those struggling with their dog’s behavior.

We are beyond grateful for the training we received with Shyenne and Beyond the Dog. When we first started, our dog Cashew was very reactive, and taking him on walks—especially around busy areas or other dogs—was stressful for all of us. Shyenne’s guidance completely changed that.

Through her patient, consistent, and knowledgeable approach, Cashew has transformed. He’s confident and calm now, and we can take him anywhere—whether it’s dinner out, a child’s birthday party, or a big walk through a busy park. The difference is night and day, and we can actually enjoy all the things we used to avoid.
Shyenne went above and beyond just “dog training”—she gave us the tools, confidence, and support to set Cashew up for success in the long run. We couldn’t be more thankful for the time, care, and expertise she put into working with our family.

If you’re considering training, I can’t recommend Beyond the Dog and Shyenne enough. They’ve truly made a lasting impact on our lives with Cashew.

We used Beyond the Dog to train our two boys, Joey and Jenga, for general reactivity/barking and leash walking, and couldn’t be happier with how the program turned out. We worked with Shyenne - who made the whole program easy for us, was a fantastic communicator, and was so great to our boys. We’ve noticed a night and day shift in their behavior since starting and would recommend Shyenne and Beyond the Dog to anyone!

🌟 Five-Star Review for Sheyenne at Beyond the Dog 🌟

Working with Sheyenne has been an absolute game-changer for me and my French Bulldog, Teddy. After trying two other trainers, I was beginning to feel defeated—until Sheyenne stepped in with her deep expertise, genuine compassion, and a training approach that finally made sense.

From day one, Sheyenne showed that she truly cared about Teddy’s success. She didn’t just see a reactive dog—she saw a sensitive pup with specific triggers and the potential to thrive. Her ability to understand Teddy’s behavior and guide him through healthier coping strategies was nothing short of remarkable.

Thanks to Sheyenne, Teddy has transformed into a calm, confident dog who can control his impulses. Our walks, which used to be stressful and unpredictable, are now peaceful and enjoyable. But the magic didn’t stop with Teddy—Sheyenne also trained me. She gave me the tools, knowledge, and confidence to support Teddy long-term, and that empowerment has made all the difference.

What sets Sheyenne apart is her refusal to use fear or intimidation. Instead, she built trust, used positive reinforcement, and tailored her methods to Teddy’s unique needs. Her approach was thoughtful, respectful, and incredibly effective.

If you're looking for a trainer who blends professionalism with heart, and who will treat your dog like the individual they are, Sheyenne is the one. Teddy and I are living proof that with the right guidance, transformation is possible. 🐾💛

Spoke with Megan (probably butchered the spelling) but the service is great! Awesome and easy to talk to! Makes setting things up a walkin in the park! Highly recommend this company for future dog training
Lindsey is amazing. Finny is learning so much.

We were at our wits end with our 7 month extremely active Weimeraner puppy- not sleeping at night, not obeying commands learned at other out of home training courses and chewing through the house. Sheyenne restored normalcy to our household which includes an older weim. Within the the first few weeks our pup learned to walk outside without pulling, not bolt through doorways, not swallow everything in sigh nor pounce/jump on anyone walking through the door.  Sheyenne was amazing, strict when needed and loving with our pup. She earned his trust and he looked forward to his sessions. A god portion of her time was spent training us and analyzing our behaviors and home situation that were causing some of the issues. Can’t recommend her or the training methodology they use enough!

I cannot say enough good things about the work Shyenne did with Kirby and Reggie. Kirby is 14 and Reggie is 4. Kirby was reactive and resource guarding in the house and Reggie had food reactivity and fence line reactivity that had redirected onto Kirby more than once.
The results: The work we did with Kirby helped immensely with her relationship with my wife. Kirby used to bark constantly when my wife would walk into a room where I was sitting with Kirby. After working with Shyenne, Kirby doesn’t bark but often even greets my wife with a wagging tail when she walks into a room. The biggest improvement we saw in Reggie was his leash walking and his fence line work. He has a very high prey drive and would react to other dogs on walks. He now walks patiently and gently by our sides and completely ignores other dogs and maintains his obedience in the presence of small animals. Within the bounds of our fence and along the fenceline, Reggie is a completely different dog relative to when Shyenne started training him. As soon as he sees a distraction, like another dog walking, he comes to me instead of reacting loudly and sometimes aggressively at the fence. I no longer worry about other dogs passing when I take Reggie in the front yard to go to the bathroom. I also think that Reggie and Kirby‘s relationship has gotten much better.

The methods: Shyenne was really great to work with overall. Both of my dogs absolutely loved her and would stare at the door after she left. She was patient and always insured they were safe in all of the training. I had been worried before starting the training since Reggie had bitten Kirby before, but Shyenne and Dr. Savage always put the dogs’ safety first. Shyenne was very approachable and comfortable to talk to from day one. She always answered all my questions and sent very thorough notes that she went over before and after each lesson. I have worked with a lot of dog trainers and the thing that stood out the most with Shyenne and Dr. Savage is that they worked to find solutions that fit our life. They did not come in with a close minded view of how our house was going to operate. They realized that Kirby was older and her training was going to look different than Reggie’s. Whenever we set a new boundary for the dogs, Shyenne always asked if it was something that I thought would be possible for us. This is not one size fits all dog training. This is thoughtful, considerate relationship improvement between us and our dogs. All four of us are going to miss Shyenne‘s daily visits, but we are so excited to live a more balanced life with more freedom for the dogs now that they can walk and be around other dogs without reacting. I can’t recommend Shyenne and Beyond The Dog enough and will absolutely be using them with any future dogs that we have. Thank you so much Shyenne and Kirby and Reggie are definitely going to miss hanging out with you on a regular basis!!

My fiancé and I couldn’t be more pleased with the exceptional service provided by Beyond the Dog. We are especially grateful to our trainer, Shelby—her dedication, expertise, and genuine care made a lasting impression on both us and our dog, HoneyBun. Most importantly, HoneyBun absolutely adored her!

Thanks to Shelby’s guidance, HoneyBun has made remarkable progress and is truly a transformed dog. The only downside is that we know he’ll miss her dearly!

If you’re considering this service for your dog, don’t hesitate—it’s an investment you won’t regret.

I seriously can’t say enough amazing things about this program (22 hour reactivity training), it was exactly what I needed and then some. Shelby helped my dog get to a place I honestly didn’t think was possible. I used to be embarrassed to take him out in public, and now I look forward to taking him places and watching people be so impressed with how well behaved he is. What I really loved was she acknowledged that we weren’t just covering up reactivity with obedience, we were truly training OUT the reactivity.  On top of everything, Shelby was always incredibly supportive, patient, and responsive. Whether it was answering my 5000 questions or coming up with different solutions when things weren’t going well, she was always there.
As someone who is ALWAYS working, this was the perfect program for me. My dog got the training he needed without me needing to be there for every session, however I still felt appropriately involved with the once weekly sessions. My schedule is also super complicated and the scheduler (and Shelby) were super accommodating which I really appreciated. Again, I can’t say enough good things!

Shyenne, our trainer, was absolutely wonderful in getting our new puppy, Winnie to be a respectable member of our family.  When we called Beyond the Dog, Winnie was jumping on everyone, refusing to go potty outside and dragging us down the street on walks.  Using non-shock/pain tactics, they taught us how to redirect her behavior and our family is now confident in how to address new behaviors as they arise.  Can’t recommend them and Sheyenne enough!

I adopted Hazel from a shelter, a 5 ½ yr old Australian Cattle Dog/ Retriever/Husky, mix, and knew she would need some training.  I wanted in home training instead of dropping her off at a facility.   I did not want to add any additional stress to her life since she had been returned to the shelter many times.  She was highly reactive to other dogs, cats, school busses, UPS, FEDX,
Amazon, etc.  When the neighbor’s dog, who was NOT on a leash, came barking at us and towards us, Hazel got out of her collar and harness and went after the dog.   I was now afraid to take Hazel for a walk for fear of what she would do.  That is when I contacted Beyond the Dog for help and enrolled in the Executive program, 16-hours of training.
Upon first meeting Shelby, I knew she was the trainer for us.  Hazel really liked her and I felt very confident with the success we would have.  Shelby has a great understanding of how to train dogs with a loving and caring attitude.  Shelby not only had to train Hazel but also me, LOL. She always showed Hazel Love and affection and gave Hazel praise while instilling corrections. She also had a lot of patience and understanding with me.  Every Friday I received an email with the lesson notes and lesson times for the upcoming week.  If I had any questions on the weekends, I could always text Shelby.
After all of our hours of training from Shelby, along with the new collar and harness, I feel confident in taking Hazel for walks again.  Hazel no longer lunges at the school bus, garbage trucks or vans.  I also feel more confident when I open the door to visitors.  Hazel now sits and waits for them to enter our home instead of jumping up to greet them.  I will continue to work with Hazel and improve on everything she has learned from Shelby.  If I ever feel a need for additional training for Hazel, I would absolutely contact Beyond the Dog and request Shelby.  I would also highly recommend Shelby and at home training with Beyond the Dog.
Thank you again Shelby
Patty D. and Hazel

Lindsey is the best! She worked a miracle with our dog Emma. We adopted Emma from Madisonville Animal Shelter. When she was a puppy, she was abandoned in a house with her siblings. The neighbors called animal control to let them know about abandoned puppies in the house. However, the new owner arrived and shot Emma's puppy siblings in front of her. Animal control officers showed up right as the new owner was about to kill Emma and her last remaining sister. They took Emma and her sister to their outdoor no kill shelter where she stayed for 8 months. Because of Emma's trauma and her isolation at the shelter, she had a lot of fear issues when we adopted her. Her first night with us was her first time being in a house since the one she was abandoned in. It was hard getting her through doorways because she had a lot of fear. We decided to call Beyond the Dog right away. Lindsey came and spent a lot of time working with her. It took a week for Emma to let her get near her. Lindsey was very dedicated to winning her over. She was so patient and wonderful with her. Emma came out of her shell and Lindsey was able to work with her on basic commands and on getting her out around people. Emma built a strong bond with Lindsey and was excited by Lindsey's visits and even gave her kisses. One of my big worries with Emma was getting her to a vet and letting them give her shots. At the beginning, I could not see how that would have been possible. She had a lot of trust issues. She was very fearful of men (even my dad). Lindsey worked on socializing her and getting her out in public around people. At the end of the training program, Lindsey came with us to the vet and we got to watch Emma get shots from the vet. Our vet was even very impressed by Lindsey and the Beyond the Dog. Now that Emma is finished with training, she has a lot of confidence and even goes up to people. Lindsey truly trains with love. We are very thankful for all her time and effort with Emma.

My four-year-old Aussiedoodle, Denver, who weighs 70 pounds, recently completed a five-week training program with Shyenne. I am astounded by the remarkable results Shyenne achieved with my dog. Denver had a traumatic experience when he was a puppy when he was attacked by another large dog. This incident resulted in concerning behavior when he walked up on a leash and approached other dogs that reminded him of his former attacker. He would bark and lunge at incoming dogs, making walking him a miserable experience. Additionally, he would become hyperactive towards squirrels, chasing after them and occasionally causing me to fall over.

Shyenne was incredibly easy to work with. She demonstrated the correct ways to handle Denver, and everyone who knew him before the training is amazed by the positive changes. I am also truly impressed with Denver’s progress. He no longer jumps on people, allowing me to have company at home again. Shyenne was always responsive and kind to me and Denver. She was always a phone call away, and it warms my heart to witness the bond they have formed. She has become an integral part of our family, and I am grateful to have crossed paths with Shyenne. I cannot recommend her enough.

Initially, when I was unsure about which training program to choose, I was tempted to opt for the boarding training, which was more expensive. However, during our initial introduction call, Sean convinced me to go with the program that would be more beneficial for Denver while being more affordable. It is evident that the company genuinely cares about the well-being of your beloved puppy, prioritizing their needs above all else.

I rescued a malinios mix from the middle of a busy road. After finding out she had no chip or tag, I took her home. After some time we figured out she had no one looking for her, but unfortunately she was not fitting in well at our house. She would jump and knock over our small children, did not respect the boundaries our 8 year old husky was setting for her, and worst of all was aggressive with our cats to the point she could not be loose in the house with them. It became a high stress situation that was affecting everyone. The dog, Desna, had meanwhile decided to devote herself to me and looked at me with stars in her eyes, and I could not bring myself to betray that love and take her to a shelter. That is when we found Beyond the Dog, and they sent over their miracle worker Shelby. I was highly doubtful it was going to be successful, but I had to try. It was a lot of work, but Shelby was confident, knowledgeable, and patient and helped us get through it. I can’t believe it, but Desna is now able to fit in at our house and fit in peacefully! It is truly nothing short of a miracle, and I’m so thankful I get to keep my new running partner!

Absolutely amazing experience working with Shyenne. Luna went from a puppy who pulled like crazy, was absolutely terrified of people and other dogs, terrified of trucks, and didn’t want to listen at all to being absolutely amazing on walks and in general! In just the five weeks of the program she has learned to perfectly loose leash walk and learned all basic obedience commands along with the fearful behavior nearly completely gone. She’s nearly perfect to the point I’d be comfortable having her off leash and she’s just 10 months old.

Any dog training needs a lot of commitment and dedication from the owner to be successful. Shyenne gave Luna all the foundations to be successful and instilled great habits in both her and me. I couldn’t ask for anything more and now I feel more connected to my puppy than ever.

Thanks so much to Shyenne and the team at Beyond the Dog!
Ben was great. We have four rescues who struggled with various levels of barking reactivity and they are doing so much better. Thank you Beyond the Dog!

We hired Beyond the Dog to help us with our new puppy. We had a great experience with them. Our trainer Shyenne did an exceptional job. The lessons were all well structured and efficient and she was friendly and worked well with our dog - he looked forward to the lessons.  At the end of each week Shyenne would send a summary of the week along with key items to practice between lessons. Our dog has done great and has great obedience - especially given his young age. Highly recommend.

Shyenne did a phenomenal job working through a five week training course with our 8 month old goldendoodle, Lilah.  Shyenne was able to work through several major issues with our puppy, particularly related to resource guarding and interacting with our elementary age daughter while also managing to teach Lilah basic skills.  She also coordinated around our busy work schedule and kept true to the schedule promised at the start of our program.  A huge perk was also that the training was performed in our home and Lilah therefore easily continued the skills learned during the training after it was over since the environment remained the same.  Would highly recommend Shyenne!
